title: Migrate remaining purchase cost and tax summary into controlled financial datasets
description: Expose the two remaining fixed financial report families via existing generic platform. Reuse existing IReportService calculations for demonstrably safe source partitions; do not copy new business algorithms. Legacy purchase-cost groups only supplier, tax-summary only period although both sources have currency. Reject ambiguous or mixed-currency grain before calling legacy sums, disclose the compatibility limitation rather than emitting unsafe totals. Any additional legacy read-only overload must preserve old methods/routes and share original calculations. Stage 2 only; no dedicated business-report controller/designer/exporter, arbitrary SQL, schema/migrations/production operations, secrets/env edits, permission expansion or unrelated changes. Preserve old entries until every migration has genuine parity acceptance. Tests may write only guarded (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance / NEWERP_AUTOTEST_* databases.
acceptance_criteria: Provide finite purchase-cost and tax-refund-summary dataset catalogs, metrics, bounded preview and immutable presets for both fixed registry keys, preserving original fields, date/status rules and unknown values with generic Excel/PDF output.

Recheck original purchase-cost/tax-refund-summary menu authorization and current-user data scope before each catalog/query/export. Global unscoped legacy calculations must fail closed for restricted users. Currency/unit mixtures or ambiguous supplier/period identity must be rejected before aggregation, never silently mixed or relabeled; retain evidence and bounded audited errors.

Verify legacy-versus-generic semantics on safe uniform-currency partitions, mixed-currency rejection before unsafe service calls, missing/revoked authorization, dates/pages and empty rows. Add real isolated SQL fixtures and export assertions; run related tests, safe Release build/unit suite and scheduler self-test/contracts. Mark incomplete browser/source compatibility accurately; presence is readiness only, not parity-passed or phase completion.
implementation_evidence: Verified ReportController fixed routes, IReportService.cs signatures, ReportService.Extra.cs:GetPurchaseCostAsync and Extra2.cs:GetTaxRefundSummaryAsync. ReportMigrationRegistryDtos has both keys; current catalog/preset/providers and existing task history have neither. PurchaseCostItem/TaxRefundSummaryItem have no currency and legacy grouping omits it; BaseTaxRefund.Currency and PurchaseOrder.Currency exist, requiring explicit safety boundary.
